scenes.vo: Why does antivirus miss brand new malware? A signature is a fingerprint of a file someone has already seen. Change one byte, and the fingerprint changes. No match.
scenes.caption: Why does antivirus miss brand new malware? A signature is a fingerprint of a file someone has already seen. Change one byte, and the fingerprint changes. No match.

scenes.vo: Attackers know this. They rebuild the same malware again and again, so every copy looks new to the list.
scenes.caption: Attackers know this. They rebuild the same malware again and again, so every copy looks new to the list.

scenes.chapter: The wait for a new signature
scenes.vo: Then there is the wait. A new signature has to be written and shipped before a list can stop that file. Until it arrives, the file can run.
scenes.caption: Then there is the wait. A new signature has to be written and shipped before a list can stop that file. Until it arrives, the file can run.

scenes.vo: Zero Write has no signature to wait for. A file no one has seen before is judged on what it would do, on the machine, when it arrives. Reputation lookups only add detail.
